name: Am I Alone?
source:
What's your first instinct when you find yourself waking up alone in the middle of the night, with nothing but the faint hum of a tv buzzing in your ears? Are you a survivor, or are you an explorer? 

[From [url=https://crimson-door-studio.itch.io/am-i-alone]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当你发现自己半夜独自醒来，耳边只有电视微弱的嗡嗡声时，你的第一直觉是什么？你是幸存者，还是探险家？

[来自[url=https://crimson-door-studio.itch.io/am-i-alone]Itch.io[/url]]
